defects.claim: Failed page allocation leaves a phantom page claim in `pages`, so later uploads collide and texture(id) has nothing to bind
defects.scenario: Page texture allocation throws after the page ID is claimed; regular uploads under the ID are treated as collisions, so texture(id) returns nothing to bind

defects.claim: Image cache reused after disposal is never re-added to `live`, so releaseImageSource and the latest-frame query miss its new texture
defects.scenario: Dispose an image cache, then upload to it again; the new texture is untracked globally
defects.cause: dispose removes live membership that reuse never restores

defects.claim: Failed attribute replacement leaves the old mesh entry cached, whose resources were already queued for transient cleanup and get deleted by freeTransient
defects.scenario: Replacement allocation throws; after freeTransient, a request matching the previous attribute gets a handle to deleted GL resources
defects.cause: old resources released before fallible allocation

defects.claim: subImageR8/subImageRGBA skip the kind check uploadR8/uploadRGBA enforce, so glyph bytes get written into a texture that belongs to an image
defects.scenario: an image is registered (or `upload`ed) under an id a dynamic glyph page later uses, e.g. `weasel-dyn-sdf-page-0`. `uploadR8` → `claimPage` sees the id taken by a non-page, warns "only the one made first is kept", and does nothing. But `dynamicPages.sync` (packages/font/src/dynamic/dynamicPages.ts:84-98) sees `cache.has(id)` true, skips the upload and patches: `subImageR8` looks the id up through `texture(id)` with no `pages` check and calls `writeSubTexture` with w×h single-channel bytes on the RGBA8 image texture. WebGL raises INVALID_OPERATION (or WebGPU a validation error) and nothing is written, or, for `subImageRGBA`, glyph texels overwrite the image's and its mipmaps are regenerated. Expected: the collision is settled one way, as `claimPage`/`collidesWithPage` settle it: the patch methods refuse a non-page id too.
defects.cause: page ownership checked on create, not on patch

defects.claim: A font-atlas upload under an id already registered drops that id from the sweep, so its texture outlives the registry entry
defects.scenario: id `x` is drawn through `uploadRegistered` (added to `registered`), then a font atlas is uploaded under the same id with `upload`, which does `registered.delete(id)` and rewrites the texture (warned). When the texture registry later drops `x`, `sweep` never visits it, so the GPU texture lives until `free()`. Expected: the collision keeps one owner but the texture is freed once neither owner holds it.
defects.cause: ownership flag cleared rather than shared
